requests.name: act_breathe_into_paper_bag
requests.why: 공황장애 통념 반박 대목('이럴 때 종이봉투에 대고 숨을 쉬라는 말 … 30초 만에 핏속 산소가 눈에 띄게 떨어졌어요. 그래서 지금은 권하지 않아요')의 행위 클립이자 negations의 빨간 X가 얹힐 '틀린 행동' 장면. 라이브러리에 봉투·마스크처럼 입을 덮고 숨 쉬는 행위 클립이 하나도 없다 — act_hold_one_breast(가슴 감싸기)·act_gasp_for_breath(계단 헐떡임)로는 '봉투에 대고 숨 쉰다'가 안 보여 X를 그어도 무엇을 하지 말라는지 모른다. 봉투가 입·코를 덮고 숨에 맞춰 부풀었다 꺼지는 게 화면에 보여야 한다. 피해야 할 것: 가슴을 움켜쥐는 동작(이미 act_clutch_chest가 같은 영상 도입부에 나온다), 쓰러지는 장면(봉투 때문에 쓰러진다는 오해를 준다 — 원고는 '산소가 떨어졌다'까지만 말한다).
requests.midjourney: Medical holographic visualization of a single translucent glass-like human figure seated on a plain low block, every structure rendered in the same soft pale cyan glow, dark empty slate blue-grey void, cinematic soft rim lighting, vertical 9:16 portrait frame, smooth featureless face, seated body visible from the top of the head to the feet, both feet flat on the floor. The figure hunches forward with the elbows resting on the knees and both hands holding the gathered open end of a plain crumpled paper bag of the same translucent cyan glass sealed over the mouth and nose, the bag puffed half full in front of the face, the shoulders raised. The lungs inside the chest are visible through the glass shell. --ar 9:16 --no text, letters, numbers, labels, arrows, watermark, logo, UI, interface, amber, orange, red, blood colour, opaque skin, clothing, hair, facial features, printed bag, brand marks, handles, other people, duplicated limbs
requests.flow: One continuous shot in a single unbroken scene with no scene cuts, the camera easing slowly forward from the seated full body toward the chest and the bag. 0-1.5s: from the very first frame the hunched figure holds the paper bag sealed over the mouth and nose and breathes out hard, the bag puffing up full, then breathes in fast and the bag crumples flat against the face, the shoulders jerking up with the in-breath. 1.5-3s: two more quick shallow breaths in the same rhythm, the bag swelling and collapsing each time, and the lungs inside the chest start glowing amber with each in-breath. 3-4.5s: the breaths grow faster and shallower, the bag pumping in and out in a tight rhythm while the hands grip its gathered edge harder, and the camera keeps pushing in until the chest and the bag fill the frame. 4.5-6s: the bag puffs and crumples twice more and the lungs throb intense amber twice with those breaths, staying fully lit until the very last frame, while every other organ, every bone and the glass skin stay soft pale cyan. The figure stays seated and upright throughout, never slumping or falling. The body stays translucent glass with all organs visible inside throughout; the face stays smooth and featureless, the dark slate blue-grey void stays empty. No text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no arrows anywhere in the frame. The audio is a low synth hum with the dry crinkle of the paper bag and quick muffled breaths, no music, no dialogue.
